newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Seagram debt rating, trend.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Seagram debt rating, trend.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Thursday that it had confirmed a rating of A (high) on debentures for The Seagram Company Ltd and a rating of R-1 (middle) on the company's commercial paper.
DBRS also said it had confirmed a stable trend for Seagram.

"The balance sheet remains strong with good coverage ratios. Debt levels are moderate and will decline further with an expected debt repayment from part of the recent sale of 30 million shares of its Time Warner Inc holding," DBRS said.
